hub.conclusion: The active 68141322AA/68289895AA SD/USB/AUX module already carries downstream device enumeration, standard and class/vendor control traffic, disconnects, and sustained MTP/iPod/mass-storage data over one radio-facing USB path. AOA keeps the radio as host, so no CarPlay-style role reversal is required and no recovered filtering rule targets Google accessory IDs.
hub.limits: Exact hub or mux silicon, packet-level behavior, C2-to-controller routing, power budget, Google VID/PID observation, and physical AOA traffic remain unobserved; this is strong architectural support, not PROVED TRANSPARENT.

ownership.current_owner: On a generic Android phone that advertises the Microsoft-compatible MTP identifier, enum-devices invokes enum-usb check_MS_desc, the MTP rule launches io-fs-media -dpfs for the selected bus/device/interface, and iofs-pfs.so becomes the bulk-transfer owner. connmgr observes only configured USB classes and has trackUnhandledUsbDevice=0; it is not the generic MTP bulk owner.
ownership.intercept: The AOA negotiator must receive the initial device after descriptor/MS-OS classification but before the MTP/MTPZ rule launches io-fs-media and iofs-pfs claims the interface. After START_ACCESSORY detach, the same owner must recognize 18D1:2D00/2D01 before normal unknown-device disposal and claim the first accessory bulk interface.
lifecycle: iofs-pfs selects and claims the MTP interface
detach callback, abort/release, and driver exit
ownership.narrowest_change: Add an authorized pre-MTP AOA classifier/owner that gets first refusal for eligible phones, suppresses the MTP launch during negotiation, survives logical detach as service state, recognizes Google accessory re-enumeration, and releases back to normal enumeration on failure. No stock configuration change is authorized by this report.

phase7.blocker: No existing stock-authorized process or service exposes a caller-controlled route that combines arbitrary AOA vendor requests, detach/re-enumeration ownership, accessory-interface claiming, and bounded bulk IN/OUT. The matching libusbdi primitives exist, but executing a new native caller is blocked by the unresolved legitimate signing/authorization environment.
phase7.exact_execution_surface: There is no complete legitimate AOA execution surface in the bounded recovered RA4 build. The closest components are fixed-purpose production-internal clients: enum-usb can issue a Microsoft OS descriptor vendor request and select configurations; iofs-pfs, devb-umass, and devc-serusb can perform class-bound bulk/control/reset operations; usb_hub_oc and usbPowerSwitch can monitor or cycle USB power. None accepts the structured AOA sequence or arbitrary deterministic bulk frames.
phase7.external_instrumentation: A passive analyzer can answer whether the hub forwards traffic only after some authorized host originates that traffic. A transparent active interposer could act as the AOA host, but that would prove phone-plus-hub wiring behavior, not RA4-originated control, RA4 ownership, or RA4 bulk I/O; it therefore does not justify classification C.
phase7.prototype_policy: Create only a host-executable deterministic AOA state machine and mock USB device labeled NOT TARGET VERIFIED; create no RA4/QNX binary, build file, installer, service, Xlet, firmware, or companion projection implementation.

projection_contract.device_connection_manager: A separate ModuleLink/SvcIPC destination supplies projection-device status through DCM events. Exact projection device enum values and an owner implementation were not recovered.
projection_contract.expected_owner: A missing optional, variant, licensed, or shared/newer Harman projection backend is the evidence-supported inference. The CMC_MY16_Trunk provenance and Cinemo/GAL vocabulary are leads, not proof of deployment or Android USB ownership.
projection_contract.gateway: The recovered hmiGateway fixed destination table rejects phoneProjectionService and DeviceConnectionManager before command invocation, nameHasOwner, or owner-change subscription. Registering those names alone would not make the route reachable.
projection_contract.phone_projection_service: The HMI expects startProjection with opaque ppId and subscribes to projectionSessionStatus, projectionBackToCar, now-playing, navigation, call, and device status. It checks service-owner availability through the shared ModuleLink span client.
projection_contract.usb_relationship: No recovered command, argument, event, or owner proves that phoneProjectionService or DeviceConnectionManager performs AOA, MTP arbitration, USB role management, or endpoint ownership. The contract is a designed insertion point for projection lifecycle/status, while its USB implementation remains absent or outside the bounded corpus.
